amendments.title: Scope the arbitrary-kernel S01e generalization
destinations: independent expected types and native S01 consumers
amendments.old: The arbitrary causal-w generalization could be read as including Möbius residual rigidity.
amendments.new: A causal nonzero w in L²(0,∞), or with local L² regularity on every tested prefix, and an exact finite left support endpoint yields the shifted-prefix Gram positivity result. Support alone does not ensure finite Gram entries: w(t)=1_(0,1)(t)/t is a counterexample. Residual coefficient rigidity additionally requires the actual local relation v=Σμ(n)g_n on that interval. Discharge the relation in the native instance through the source/convolution identities. Keep the inherited source record unchanged and reject an arbitrary target0 used to infer coefficients→μ.

requirements.title: Claim authority, exact types and dependency provenance
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**Requirement BASE-01.** Every claim used in the eventual proof must
retain its authority label, exact theorem statement, version, and
hypotheses. Acceptance requires a dependency record distinguishing a
proved implication from a proved premise, and distinguishing a finite
certificate from a universal theorem. Obsolete conditional registry
descriptions must not override a newer proved declaration, and a newer
declaration must not be credited with a stronger conclusion than its
type.
requirements.carry_forward: Preserve exact type, pin, hypothesis and receipt; inventory and compiler authority stay distinct.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: True-zeta target with complete zero, gamma and pole conventions
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**Requirement BASE-02.** The final target must refer to the genuine
Riemann zeta function and the existing definition of RiemannHypothesis.
Acceptance includes the nontrivial-zero domain, multiplicities where
relevant, the standard functional equation and gamma/pole normalization,
and the final connection to the project’s zero configuration. A theorem
about a synthetic prime system, an auxiliary real-zero function, or a
modified matrix is not the terminal target.
requirements.carry_forward: Actual zeta, nontrivial zeros, multiplicity, pole/gamma normalization and reflection; synthetic controls are not target replacements.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Choose sufficient terminal contract and preserve its quantifier order
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**Requirement TARGET-01.** The selected output contract and its
quantifier order must be written before evaluating a candidate.
Acceptance is an exact composition from the existing generator to a
contradiction. Cofinal positive apertures cannot be justified from
unbounded badness alone; their sufficiency here uses the stronger
theorem (3).
requirements.carry_forward: Write sufficient quantifiers; add the fixed-filter consumer while leaving its approximation premise open.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Do not add unnecessary success conditions
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**Requirement TARGET-02.** Do not add unnecessary success conditions. A
universal detector index, a common finite cutoff, positivity at every
aperture, a nonvanishing spectral gap uniform in aperture, all-real
coefficients only, or completion of every research track is not part of
the general specification. Additional conditions introduced by a chosen
method must themselves be proved or the method must be narrowed.
requirements.carry_forward: Routes are alternatives; no universal gap, bounded input, all-path completion or common finite cutoff is silently added.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: State identity and provenance.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-01 State identity and provenance.** Every relation combined on the
residual route must start from the same named state $s$, or from an
explicitly defined image of it. The record must include the
zero-dependent existence choices where used, physical cell, aperture,
cutoff, selected parity, negative shift, nonzero vector, legal moments,
metric, and ground equation. It must distinguish the true groundTrial
from a historical zero-shift trial. **Acceptance:** a reader can
substitute the same symbols into all premises without making an
additional existential choice or identifying different vectors by
notation. \[S2–S5\]
requirements.carry_forward: Same generated state or proved image; current original detector, finite ground, full contact and new probe remain distinct.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Transformation strength.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-02 Transformation strength.** Every representation map must state
exactly what it preserves: quadratic value, sign, norm, eigenvalue,
ground minimality, source moments, parity, or only existence of a
negative vector. **Acceptance:** downstream arguments use only the
preserved properties. An isometry preserves norm; transporting energy
additionally requires a proved form identity or intertwining. A
congruence transports inertia under its stated invertibility conditions.
Similarity transports eigenvalues but need not transport Hermitian
positivity. A Schur projection normally changes the vector and does not
preserve its original moments.
requirements.carry_forward: Record energy/norm/inertia/visibility preservation separately; congruence is not isometry and smoothing has no bounded reverse.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Normalization and complex scalars.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-03 Normalization and complex scalars.** The proof must fix the
inner-product convention, Fourier sign, centering phase, support units,
source coefficients and normalization. If $u = cv$ with $c \neq 0$,
quadratic energies scale by $|c|^{2}$, while linear moments and the
source functional scale by $c$. **Acceptance:** every normalization
divides only by a proved nonzero quantity and transports the prime
remainder and budget together. A real-vector restriction requires an
explicit decomposition theorem valid for the actual Hermitian form.
requirements.carry_forward: Retain complex conjugation, exact delay, one-copy Q, source normalization and all nonzero divisors.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Additive identity if used.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-04 Additive identity if used.** The available PAPER bridge uses

$$f_{L,u}(x) = L^{- 1/2}\mathbf{1}_{\lbrack 0,L\rbrack}(x)\sum_{n = - K}^{K}u_{n}e^{2\pi inx/L},\quad\quad F_{f}(t) = \int f(x)e^{- itx}\, dx.$$

It proves $\parallel f_{L,u} \parallel_{2} = \parallel u \parallel$ and

$$Q_{Weil}\left( f_{L,u} \right) = u^{*}S_{L,K}u.\quad\quad\text{(4)}$$

The factor is one. **Acceptance:** the exact pole pairing
$2\Re\left( F_{f}(i/2)\overline{F_{f}( - i/2)} \right)$, complete
digamma contribution, every prime power, and source correction occur
exactly once. Full source aperture $L$ corresponds to external
half-width $L/2$. The complete complex domain is retained. A separately
defined multiplicative carrier requires its own identity; (4) does not
identify all similarly named forms automatically. \[R2, S11\]
requirements.carry_forward: Reuse exact physical finite-Weil identity on legal coefficients, including pole/gamma/prime terms once.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Analytic operations and regularity.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-05 Analytic operations and regularity.** Every interchange, limit,
integration by parts, derivative, and operator extension must have a
domain and a convergence justification. The supported logarithmic form
domain is described by

$$J(f) = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{\mathbb{R}}^{}\left\lbrack A_{\infty}(t) - A_{\infty}(0) \right\rbrack\left| F_{f}(t) \right|^{2}dt < \infty,$$

where $A_{\infty}(t) = \Re\psi(1/4 + it/2) - \log\pi$. The preceding
PAPER proof gives the smooth form core and hard-window membership. For
actual boundary-flat vectors, the repository already proves a compactly
supported global $C^{2}$ extension; zero-trace $H^{1}$ membership
follows by an elementary analytic bridge. **Acceptance:** use the
available regularity actually needed, prove any stronger regularity
being invoked, and state the topology in which every limiting identity
holds. Totalized integrals do not establish convergence. \[R2, S12\]
requirements.carry_forward: All transforms, integrals, tails, derivatives and limits need the declared native domain and convergence topology.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Finite and continuous operators.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-06 Finite and continuous operators.** If an external theorem
concerns a full continuous ground state, the proof must separately
establish why it applies to the chosen finite state or construct and
control a new continuous ground. Equation (4) preserves the quadratic
value; the finite eigen-equation generally supplies only a Galerkin
equation. **Acceptance:** a new continuous ground has proved existence
and sign, and every finite source or moment restriction later used on it
has its own transport theorem. The continuous spectral bottom must not
be renamed $\lambda$ without proving equality. A form core is not
automatically an operator core; essential self-adjointness and
operator-core density must be proved when the selected theorem requires
them.
requirements.carry_forward: A finite eigenvector gives a Galerkin equation; no automatic full continuous eigenvector or operator-core claim. Direct causal route bypasses this only because its proof does not use that representation.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Strict even.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-07 Strict even.** Under $\lambda = a < b$, use
$B - \lambda I \succ 0$. The canonical ray is

$$v = D^{- 1}(B - \lambda I)^{- 1}g,$$

and the adapter must establish $u = H(u)v$, $H(u) \neq 0$, and
$H(v) = 1$ for the retained even ground. **Acceptance:** invoke a
negative-shift theorem with its strict gap, preserve the scalar gauge,
and transport the arithmetic from $u$. Zero-contact identities
containing $B^{- 1}$ do not apply by changing the name of the spectral
parameter.
requirements.carry_forward: If strict-even secular route used, bind actual negative shift and strict opposite gap; do not substitute zero-shift theorem.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Strict odd.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-08 Strict odd.** Under $\lambda = b < a$, use the reverse ray

$$v_{E} = (A - \lambda I)^{- 1}d,\quad\quad v_{O} = Dv_{E},\quad\quad H\left( v_{E} \right) = - 1.$$

The reverse determinant has the sign $1 + H\left( v_{E} \right)$. Source
statements on an odd vector use its even pullback. The current branch
package contains an existential odd ground in hreverse; it is not stated
to equal groundTrial. **Acceptance:** prove direct applicability to
groundTrial or prove eigenline/scalar transport, retaining all norm
factors. The reviewed quantitative odd cubic-moment estimate is an
available PAPER result, not an already exported negative-ground Lean
wrapper. \[S14, R3\]
requirements.carry_forward: If strict-odd route used, preserve reverse-ray sign and prove same-ground transport; no even M4 statement imported.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Tied ground.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-09 Tied ground.** Under $a = b = \lambda$, both shifted operators
are singular. Retain both kernels and the even selection made by the
residual type. **Acceptance:** use kernel projection or a pseudoinverse
with its kernel component. Both cases $P_{\ker(B - \lambda I)}g = 0$ and
$\neq 0$ must be covered if this classification is used. The finite
scalar limit of a secular function need not determine its vector
resolvent. A tie cannot be excluded by importing a strict-branch
inverse. At the negative first-bad tie, the predecessor argument bounds
each parity’s negative multiplicity by one; it does not establish
simplicity at every zero contact. \[R3\]
requirements.carry_forward: Tie requires whole kernels/projector and kernel components; no strict inverse or scalar removable-pole shortcut.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Contact provenance if used.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-10 Contact provenance if used.** A transition from a negative
residual to a zero contact changes the aperture and usually the vector.
If the argument uses first-crossing properties, its finite-cutoff
extraction must produce the exact first-negative boundary, with
nonnegative prefix and negative values arbitrarily close on the outgoing
side. A continuous-operator route needs its analogous proved extraction
and transport. **Acceptance:** preserve the fields actually required by
the exclusion theorem, prove its branch coverage, and independently
establish source or derivative properties at the contact. A theorem
excluding every zero contact may instead use a weaker contact
extraction. A tangent zero alone does not supply outgoing negativity.
\[S15\]
requirements.carry_forward: Actual first-negative prefix and arbitrarily close outgoing negativity must be generated; zero contact alone is insufficient.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Derivative authority if used.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-11 Derivative authority if used.** Reuse global F04 for its exact
canonical even target. Distinguish differentiation in spectral shift,
physical aperture, reciprocal aperture, and a fixed or moving vector.
**Acceptance:** include chain-rule factors, Euler correction, source
transport, and one-sided seam terms required by the selected derivative.
Odd or multiple-contact uses require an applicable theorem. F04
identifies a physical expression; its sign remains a separate question.
\[S16\]
requirements.carry_forward: Keep aperture/source/spectral derivatives, Euler correction and seam one-sided hypotheses separate.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Relation register and dependency graph.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S3-12 Relation register and dependency graph.** The Step 3 output must
list each used map or theorem with its domain, codomain, preserved
facts, hypotheses, source, status and downstream use. The graph must
distinguish equivalence, one-way implication, exact identity, inequality
and conditional transfer. **Acceptance:** every path in the proposed
proof has a theorem-backed composition. Numerical agreement and similar
terminology are not graph edges. Only the subgraph needed for the
selected sufficient contract must be completed.
requirements.carry_forward: An implication graph needs exact typed application, not only a source-only dependency edge.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Independent derivation.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-01 Independent derivation.** The closing restriction must be proved
from accepted mathematics and the actual hypotheses of the
counterexample argument. A result with RH-equivalent strength is an
admissible target. **Acceptance:** the dependency tree contains no
unproved RH, residual exclusion, global positivity, global
positive-kernel property, or renamed opposite arithmetic sign. The proof
must expose where it uses information beyond the negative-ground
identity. A contradiction may use all consequences of the hypothetical
negative state, provided no desired conclusion is inserted as a premise.
requirements.carry_forward: Independent proof of closing premise remains required; conditional wrapper is permissible only when premise is proved.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Actual applicability.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-02 Actual applicability.** The proved restriction must apply to
every state required by the chosen contract. **Acceptance:** all extra
hypotheses are derived from the generator, established independently on
the covered domain, or handled by a proved branch reduction. An
inequality for a convenient trial function, pole-neutral subspace, fixed
source gauge, or special parity remains partial if the actual state is
not shown to belong to that class.
requirements.carry_forward: Prove every extra input on the generated class; a convenient changed vector is not automatically applicable.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Incompatibility strength.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-03 Incompatibility strength.** The new result must logically
contradict the existing necessary conditions. **Acceptance:** write the
final algebraic or analytic contradiction explicitly. For the direct
arithmetic route, an upper bound $U_{s}$ is sufficient only if the proof
also gives $P_{s} + B_{s} \leq U_{s} \leq 0$. A small positive upper
bound, a relative error larger than the available margin, or another
expression equal to $P_{s} + B_{s}$ does not exclude the state. A
successful alternative can contradict a different necessary condition,
but must exhibit that contradiction equally explicitly.
requirements.carry_forward: Compare complete upper with actual retained positive lower; preserve exponent and family quantifiers.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Genuine arithmetic.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-04 Genuine arithmetic.** Where the argument distinguishes zeta from
matched modified-prime systems, it must use a proved property of the
actual coefficients or their analytic completion. **Acceptance:**
identify the exact coefficient formula
$\Lambda\left( p^{j} \right) = \log p$, the gamma and pole data,
Euler-product or functional-equation input, or other established
arithmetic theorem that does the distinguishing. Positive weights,
prime-power consistency and coarse prime asymptotics alone are
insufficient for the controls already constructed. The proof need not
fail on every artificial system; it must exclude every negative model
satisfying all premises actually used.
requirements.carry_forward: Use actual divisor/prime/gamma data to distinguish matched controls; positive weights alone do not suffice.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: All required parameters.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-05 All required parameters.** The theorem must cover variable $K$
and the aperture range of the selected contract, with no lower bound on
the hypothetical nonzero distance from the critical line.
**Acceptance:** every constant has declared dependence, and every limit
or estimate is uniform exactly where the composition requires it.
State-dependent constants are allowed when the final quantifiers remain
valid. A cutoff-dependent threshold cannot establish the
common-threshold version of TAIL without further work.
requirements.carry_forward: Declare dependence of constants, cofinal schedules and zero-dependent parameters; no illicit K/L or varying-filter quantifier switch.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Complete branch coverage.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-06 Complete branch coverage.** Every generated possibility must be
covered by a theorem or bypassed by a stronger common argument.
**Acceptance:** the branch table in Section 8 has no unresolved required
row. In particular, strict even, strict odd and tied grounds cannot be
identified. A proof of COFINAL by a direct form inequality can cover
them simultaneously and need not prove separate contact theorems.
requirements.carry_forward: Cover required even/odd/tie/seam/inherited/fresh branches, or prove a route bypass; direct B consumer does not need contact branch analysis.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Preserve information under elimination.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**S4-07 Preserve information under elimination.** Elimination must
preserve logical direction, exceptional loci and inequalities.
**Acceptance:** establish nonzero denominators, range conditions,
complex conjugation, and any positivity needed by Schur complements or
divisions. If an elimination enlarges the possible state set, prove
incompatibility on that enlarged set or retain the missing restrictions.
Polynomial syzygies alone do not preserve spectral ordering, positivity
or analytic realizability.
requirements.carry_forward: Nonzero denominators, positive complements, preserved kernel terms and complete sign data remain explicit.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Same signed integral.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**A-01 Same signed integral.** The candidate must constrain (2), or an
exactly equivalent expression, on the retained true ground. If a bound
on $\psi(x) - x$ is imported, derive its relation to the weighted
remainder $R(x)$ by justified partial summation. **Acceptance:** retain
endpoint contributions, the chain-rule factor, prime-power jumps, and
the actual signed weight $e_{u}\prime(1 - t/L)$. An upper bound on $|R|$
becomes useful only after a proved bound on the matching source-weighted
variation and a closed final budget.
requirements.carry_forward: Historical A concerns same retained ground prime remainder; current field/high-mask route needs its own exact adapter, not label identity.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Entire energy budget.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**A-02 Entire energy budget.** Local moment or endpoint information must
be combined with the older-prime contribution and the entire prime-free
budget. The PAPER strict-odd result supplies a nonzero cubic moment and
a favorable recent-prime interval, with a radius depending on the parity
gap and $K$. **Acceptance:** quantify that interval, estimate every
contribution outside it, and prove that the resulting inequality
contradicts (1). A sign on a subset of primes is not a sign for the
complete sum.
requirements.carry_forward: Keep complete arithmetic budget, old primes, endpoint/future and cross terms; subtrace or favorable prime subset is insufficient.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Gap and source normalization control.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**A-03 Gap and source normalization control.** A resolvent or moment
estimate containing $(a - \lambda)^{- 1}$, $(b - \lambda)^{- 1}$,
$\parallel H \parallel$, or a normalization factor must track it through
the final inequality. **Acceptance:** either prove the necessary bound
in the covered branch, show cancellation with a justified nonzero
factor, or treat the small-gap and tie regimes separately. Neither a
fitted lower gap nor a source normalization sampled at one ground is
admissible.
requirements.carry_forward: Retain gap/source factors through final budget and handle small gaps/ties; no fitted uniform gap.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Generate the correct first boundary.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**B-01 Generate the correct first boundary.** Starting from a negative
witness, construct a fixed-cutoff positive/negative bracket and its
boundary using the exact continuity theorem. **Acceptance:** the
boundary has zero ground value, a nonnegative prefix, and outgoing
negative values. Excluding arbitrary zeros is stronger than necessary;
harmless tangent contacts may remain. When using the full continuous
bottom instead, prove the finite-to-continuous reduction and state which
witness changes. \[S15, S17\]
requirements.carry_forward: Historical Track B is first-negative propagation. Generate fixed-cutoff positive/negative bracket, correct boundary and source transport.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Prove continuation through a vanishing margin.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**B-02 Prove continuation through a vanishing margin.** A Gronwall-type
route must independently estimate a coefficient whose integral remains
finite all the way up to the alleged crossing. It must establish
absolute continuity of the scalar margin $m$, or the corresponding
regularity hypotheses of the chosen comparison theorem. For example, if
$m\prime + Cm \geq 0$ is used with a positive initial $m$, the
comparison requires an integrable coefficient on the relevant interval
including its contact endpoint. An unbounded but integrable coefficient
is permitted. **Acceptance:** derive $C$ from established arithmetic or
operator estimates. Defining $C = - m\prime/m$ is merely an identity
until the required integrability is separately proved. Other noncrossing
principles are admissible with their own complete hypotheses.
requirements.carry_forward: Any comparison coefficient must be integrable up to contact; fitted inverse-energy connection is not a barrier.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Seam compatibility.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**B-03 Seam compatibility.** A propagation proof crossing $L = \log q$
must treat entry of each prime power, the exact endpoint correlation,
and every derivative jump used. The PAPER estimate bounds the entering
atom by $\beta_{q}J(f)/R_{\rho}\left( L - \log q \right)$, with a
coefficient tending to zero, where $\beta_{q} = \Lambda(q)/\sqrt{q}$ and
$R_{\rho}(\delta) = \int_{\delta}^{\infty}\rho(s)ds$. **Acceptance:**
prove a background estimate strong enough to absorb this relative form
bound. Small overlap length is not an $L^{2}$ operator-norm bound. A
bound relative to $J$ is not automatically relative to the vanishing
Weil margin. \[R4\]
requirements.carry_forward: Actual prime seams and relative form bounds; small overlap is not operator-norm or vanishing-Weil-energy control.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Global continuation or cofinal reach.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**B-04 Global continuation or cofinal reach.** Local extension from
$Q \geq cI$ to a slightly larger interval with $Q \geq (c/2)I$ is
available on paper. **Acceptance:** if iterated, prove that the reached
apertures have the required unbounded range. Steps that shrink as $c$
tends to zero can accumulate at a finite aperture. Higher-order
contacts, eigenvalue multiplicities, parity changes and fresh/inherited
regions must be covered unless the argument bypasses them.
requirements.carry_forward: Local extension must reach the required global/cofinal domain; finite accumulation and all branch changes remain covered.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Identify the nonredundant remainder.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**C-01 Identify the nonredundant remainder.** For each proposed
elimination, record the original relations, eliminated variables,
surviving relation and its independent premises. **Acceptance:** verify
that the survivor is not simply the characteristic equation, negative
energy, Ward identity, normalization, or the desired positivity in
another notation. Logical equivalence to RH is not a reason to discard a
target; absence of an independent proof is the relevant failure.
requirements.carry_forward: Historical compatibility remainder must carry new information; equivalence to RH is an allowed target but not its proof.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Preserve the domain of a Schur reduction.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**C-02 Preserve the domain of a Schur reduction.** If a positive
complement is eliminated, prove the complement’s lower bound, existence
and boundedness of its inverse, and the domain of the cross operator.
The exact remaining expression has the form

$$S_{eff} = H_{E} - C^{*}H_{F}^{- 1}C.$$

**Acceptance:** prove the completed-square identity and the required
sign or inertia implication. Eigenvalues need not be preserved
individually. The projected vector is a new witness; source moments of
the original ground require transport. A finite-dimensional $S_{eff}$
containing an infinite-dimensional inverse is not yet a finite
arithmetic certificate. \[R5\]
requirements.carry_forward: Exact completed square, full complement inverse domain and response; a finite matrix containing infinite inverse is not a finite certificate.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Control omitted directions.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**C-03 Control omitted directions.** Finite negative index at each
aperture does not identify a sufficient canonical Fourier cutoff and
does not prove index zero. **Acceptance:** any finite checker used for
all-$K$ positivity must include a theorem covering the entire omitted
space and its coupling to the retained space. Any asymptotic source-atom
or bulk trace law must be connected to the complete zeta-weighted
operator and the spectral edge needed for exclusion, with valid
parameter dependence.
requirements.carry_forward: Control omitted directions/couplings; finite negative index or high-tail positivity does not imply zero index.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Exact source and status.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**EXT-01 Exact source and status.** Pin the author, title, version,
theorem number, domain, assumptions, and applicable errata. Record which
proof and certificate components were inspected and which were
independently reproduced. **Acceptance:** author claims, theorem proofs,
numerical certificates, reproduction receipts, and Lean declarations
remain distinct. The research scan below covers the programmes
materially relevant to this construction; it is not a claim to have
exhaustively audited all RH literature.
requirements.carry_forward: Pin exact external theorem/version/proof scope and separate verified7/8 from reported stronger benchmark.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Independent certificate authority.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**EXT-02 Independent certificate authority.** If a computational theorem
is used as a premise, verify its complete source-to-target construction
and every finite certificate required by the theorem, together with the
analytic reduction and tails. **Acceptance:** no substitution of a
checksum, sample entry, previously recorded PASS, small scalar subset,
or host program axiom for the complete asserted sign. A finite
certificate can prove an infinite-dimensional statement only through a
proved reduction.
requirements.carry_forward: Full analytic reduction plus complete certificate authority; scalar subset/hash does not prove larger sign.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Spectral identification if used.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**EXT-03 Spectral identification if used.** Self-adjointness and real
zeros of an auxiliary characteristic function require a separate theorem
identifying the object with the zeta target. **Acceptance:** establish
the shift, normalization, completeness and limit topology needed to
transport zero exclusion. If a locally uniform analytic limit is used,
prove its nonzero target and domain; numerical matching of finitely many
zeros is insufficient. A positive shifted form does not prove the
unshifted form positive.
requirements.carry_forward: Required only if external spectral identification is used; no auxiliary self-adjoint real-zero object is identified with zeta by name.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Arithmetic estimates if used.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**EXT-04 Arithmetic estimates if used.** A zero-density,
pair-correlation, PNT or finite-height result must be converted to an
estimate on the covered witness class. **Acceptance:** supply an exact
source-weighted bound or an amplification theorem showing that one
off-line zero would violate the imported quantitative result. A positive
proportion, density-one statement, or finite verification can leave
isolated exceptions.
requirements.carry_forward: Convert arithmetic/density/finite-height input into exact source-weighted estimate; a positive ceiling is not Theta=0.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Branch-coverage or mathematically proved bypass certificate
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**Requirement COVER-01.** The finished proof must include a coverage
certificate identifying which theorem covers each required row and which
rows are bypassed by the selected contract. A row marked irrelevant
needs a mathematical reason, not a numerical absence of that case. For a
direct all-vector inequality, most local contact rows are bypassed
because no negative vector exists to generate a contact.
requirements.carry_forward: Record a selected-route covering theorem or mathematical bypass per required branch. This crosswalk itself is not a covering proof.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Match the hypotheses.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**FALS-01 Match the hypotheses.** Before accepting a candidate, list its
full hypotheses and compare them with the relevant controls below. A
counterexample refutes a candidate only if it satisfies all those
hypotheses. Conversely, a candidate is not repaired merely by adding a
condition that has not been proved for the actual state. Record which
mathematical input excludes each otherwise matched negative control.

| **Control**                                 | **What it tests**                                                                                        | **Required interpretation**                                                                               |
|---------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Pair-D C1                                   | Carrier geometry, reversal, centered-index commutator and positive predecessors with negative successors | Structural parity squeeze alone is insufficient; full canonical arithmetic is absent                      |
| Legal K equals 2 negative source atom       | Actual moments, D and cubic source, phase and shifted overlap                                            | Source geometry and one atom’s coefficient do not determine the complete form                             |
| Generic positive rank-one secular example   | A positive increasing transform can attain its root at negative shift                                    | Positive measure or positive slope alone is not exclusion                                                 |
| Strict-branch and tied exact models         | Pseudoinverse kernel terms, removable scalar poles and singular limits                                   | Retain the full kernel and actual branch hypotheses                                                       |
| Odd-order contact family                    | Stationary contacts with optimized curvature zero and outgoing negative Schur scalar                     | No fixed finite jet list establishes general noncrossing                                                  |
| Genuine canonical K equals 4 and 5 residues | Signed secular residues on genuine positive matrices                                                     | Universal positive-residue assertions are false; no negative-ground premise was tested                    |
| Q14 genuine point and modified weights      | Near-zero margins, coefficient sensitivity and ground rotation                                           | Exact genuine arithmetic must distinguish modified systems; fixed-ray and moving-ground thresholds differ |
| Prime-power-consistent extension            | Modified finite prime bases with all their powers scaled coherently                                      | Positive weights and coarse PNT behaviour alone remain insufficient                                       |
| Endpoint packets                            | Order-one correlation on a shrinking overlap                                                             | Ordinary L2 norm does not give seam smallness; control form energy                                        |
| Compact-resolvent crossing and Schur model  | Positive high tail and finite negative index with a bad low block                                        | Compactness and finite index do not prove positivity                                                      |
| Large-aperture and variable-cutoff examples | Quantifier order and loss of constants                                                                   | Fixed-K or bounded-window success does not establish TAIL or COFINAL                                      |

The decisive exact instances already available include
$T(\mu) = 3/(2 - \mu)$, which is positive and increasing but satisfies
$T( - 1) = 1$; a fixed-$D$ family with Schur scalar $- t^{m}$ for every
odd $m \geq 3$; and genuine residue signs $( + , + , - )$ at
$K = 4,L = 13/10$ and $( + , + , - , - )$ at $K = 5,L = 11/10$. The
latter were checked by outward source intervals and exact interval
inertia. \[R3–R6\]

At the rational Q14 aperture, the certified modified-weight crossing
lies near $2.17232814518 \times 10^{- 13}$ in the multiplicative
perturbation parameter, while the original fixed-ray threshold is
different. A coherent extension of that perturbation changes the
weighted remainder uniformly by less than $1.674 \times 10^{- 12}$ and
retains a coarse PNT asymptotic. It does not retain the genuine
coefficients or completed functional equation. These are controls on
inadequate hypotheses, not counterexamples to RH. \[R6\]
requirements.carry_forward: Counterexample must satisfy the whole proposed premise set; preserve native/synthetic distinction.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Use the fastest decisive test.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**FALS-02 Use the fastest decisive test.** First test algebraic and
quantifier consistency, then matched exact low-dimensional controls,
then canonical interval cases, then expensive parameter ranges. A proof
proposal requiring all secular residues nonnegative fails immediately on
the existing genuine controls. A barrier derived by division by its
margin fails the explicit higher-order contact test unless integrability
is separately proved. A surviving candidate still needs an analytic
proof.
requirements.carry_forward: Use algebra/quantifier and existing native failures before expensive sweeps; finite optimization does not bypass them.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Preserve rejected claims precisely.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**FALS-03 Preserve rejected claims precisely.** Record the exact
falsified statement, counterexample, verified hypotheses, and scope. Do
not promote a failed lower bound into a negative value of the actual
form, or a method-specific obstruction into an impossibility theorem for
all Step 4 approaches. Repair is legitimate when the strengthened
premises are independently established on every needed generated state.
requirements.carry_forward: Preserve exact refuted claim and scope; a method failure is not general Step4 impossibility or negative actual energy.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Proof-relevant precision.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**NUM-01 Proof-relevant precision.** Every numerical sign used as proof
evidence must have exact rational or outward-rounded bounds, validated
source normalization, complete input data, and a theorem relating the
verified finite object to the claimed object. **Acceptance:** a sign
interval excludes zero in the required direction, or a non-strict
equality/sign has an exact proof. A higher precision floating-point
value is not automatically an enclosure.
requirements.carry_forward: Exact/outward enclosures with actual source-to-target theorem; floating precision alone is not a certificate.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Continuous coverage.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**NUM-02 Continuous coverage.** A continuous-aperture certificate must
prove coverage of every claimed point, including endpoints and seams,
with an error estimate valid on each covered cell. **Acceptance:** the
union of certified cells is the full stated range, every parity sector
claimed by that certificate is covered, and any omitted tail or
parameter range has its own theorem. Both sectors are required by the
combined WP4 Full or terminal positivity claim; a correctly labeled
one-parity partial certificate remains valid. A positive grid, frozen
basin or single rational aperture cannot be labeled a continuous
certificate.
requirements.carry_forward: Regional/continuous claims include all endpoints,seams,parities and omitted tails; finite points do not establish continuous cover.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Full error budget.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**NUM-03 Full error budget.** The inequality must include source
approximation, quadrature, rounding, basis conversion, compression,
complement and coupling errors, as applicable. **Acceptance:** the final
margin dominates the sum or correct quadratic combination of all errors.
Signed channel cancellations may be bounded separately only after
proving that the resulting loss still leaves a sufficient bound.
requirements.carry_forward: Include every source, quadrature, rounding, compression, complement, coupling, filter, lag and physical-output error as applicable.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Reproducibility and authority.
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**NUM-04 Reproducibility and authority.** A finite verification package
must identify its exact input hashes, dependency versions, precision and
rounding model, expected mathematical statement, checker and output.
Separate proposal generation from verification where possible.
**Acceptance:** another execution can reproduce the certificate from the
pinned inputs, and the report distinguishes interval authority from a
kernel-checked fact. Replaying a subset of a larger certificate does not
discharge the omitted obligations.
requirements.carry_forward: Pinned input/dependency/checker/rounding model and reproducible output; inherited execution distinct from fresh execution.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Step 3 selected-path composition completion
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**GATE-01.** Step 3 is complete for a selected construction when its
used representation graph composes from the existing counterexample
generator to the exact input of the proposed exclusion theorem. Every
edge has a proof, every domain and shift agrees, every change of vector
has sufficient transported properties, and every branch needed by that
construction is covered. Equivalent descriptions beyond this used graph
are optional.

The review deliverable must include the state definitions, the map
register, the normalization/domain proof, the used shifted or contact
adapters, and the source/status ledger. A collection of individually
valid theorems with incompatible witnesses does not pass.
requirements.carry_forward: Selected used graph must compose actual generator to exclusion input. Current exact producer evidence is owned by repository audit.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Step 4 paper-proof completion with no open leaf
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**GATE-02.** Step 4 is complete on paper only when a finite proof chain
establishes one sufficient terminal contract with no open mathematical
leaf. The proof must explicitly contradict a generated necessary
condition or otherwise imply RH, pass the branch assessment, and survive
independent checking of its arithmetic, limits, quantifiers and
countermodels. Independent internal review must be described accurately
and not represented as external peer review.

The shortest direct arithmetic chain has four obligations:

1.  Instantiate an arbitrary actual residual beyond the chosen common
    threshold.
2.  Transport the existing strict inequality $P_{s} + B_{s} > 0$ without
    changing its witness.
3.  Prove from independent mathematics $P_{s} + B_{s} \leq 0$ on that
    same covered state.
4.  Derive the contradiction and invoke the existing off-line-zero
    generator or terminal equivalence.

Only item 3 is the decisive missing sign; items 1 and 2 still require
exact interfaces in any changed representation. The shortest cofinal
alternative is to prove all-$K$ legal nonnegativity at arbitrarily large
common apertures and contradict (3). These are specifications of the
required output, not proofs that either output has been constructed.
requirements.carry_forward: No mathematical open leaf in a claimed closing proof; all current terminal premises remain OPEN.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: Authorized Lean and terminal claim-validation gates
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**GATE-03.** Lean implementation follows an accepted paper proof and
separate authorization. Its specification must match the mathematical
statement actually proved, discharge every imported premise through an
accepted route, and identify the permitted foundational axioms. The
existing project axiom policy permits propext, Classical.choice and
Quot.sound; additional unproved arithmetic or RH-strength axioms cannot
silently stand in for the result. Exact-head formal-validity checks,
relevant regression checks, graph consistency and claim-validation gates
must then pass. Source and certificate audits remain distinct from a
successful build.
requirements.carry_forward: Real compatible build, independent expected type, transitive standard-axiom audit, native consumer and exact receipt before promotion.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.

requirements.title: RH_OPEN firewall until complete proof passes
requirements.original_source_paragraph:
**GATE-04.** The project retains RH_OPEN until the complete proof and
formal claim-validation gates succeed. Partial improvements must be
recorded with their exact scope. A complete finite window, a new
equality, a paper adapter, a green check or an RH-equivalent target is
not itself a terminal proof.
requirements.carry_forward: Keep RH_OPEN until literal terminal proof and claim gates; finite certificate and green count cannot close RH.
requirements.source_line_note: The materialized extraction prepends6orientation lines; original register line retained separately.
